WITH P AS ( SELECT #{chkDay1} AS DT_FROM8 , #{chkDay2} AS DT_TO8 , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 5 / 1440 , 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS BEF_5M , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 10 / 1440 , 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS BEF_10M , UPPER(TRIM(#{ipUserId})) AS TGT_UID FROM DUAL ) , CHK_RAW AS ( SELECT UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *USER:([^ |]+)' , 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS USER_KEY , REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *USER:([^ |]+)' , 1, 1, NULL, 1) AS USER_ID , REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *DATE:([0-9]{8})', 1, 1, NULL, 1) AS CHK_DATE , TRIM( REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *IPD:([^|]+)' , 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS CHK_IPD , TRIM( REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *IP:([^|]+)' , 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS CHK_IP , TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *D_TOT:([0-9]+)' , 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS D_TOT , TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *D_REAL:([0-9]+)', 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS D_REAL , A.SRC_SYSTEM , A.REG_DT FROM TB_MONITOR_ALARM A , P WHERE A.REG_DT BETWEEN P.DT_FROM8 || '000000' AND P.DT_TO8 || '235959' AND A.ALARM_TITLE LIKE '%조회건수%집계%' AND UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *USER:([^ |]+)', 1, 1, NULL, 1)) = P.TGT_UID ) , CHK_PAIR AS ( SELECT R.USER_KEY , R.USER_ID , R.CHK_DATE , R.SRC_SYSTEM , R.REG_DT , TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(R.CHK_IPD, '[^,]+', 1, L.LV)) AS PAIR FROM CHK_RAW R , (SELECT LEVEL AS LV FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 50) L WHERE R.CHK_IPD IS NOT NULL AND R.CHK_IPD <> '-' AND L.LV <= REGEXP_COUNT(R.CHK_IPD, ',') + 1 ) , CHK_IP AS ( SELECT Q.USER_KEY , Q.USER_ID , Q.CHK_DATE , Q.SRC_SYSTEM , Q.REG_DT , SUBSTR(Q.PAIR, 1, INSTR(Q.PAIR, '=', -1) - 1) AS IPV , TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(Q.PAIR, '=([0-9]+)/[0-9]+$', 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS D_TOT , TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(Q.PAIR, '/([0-9]+)$' , 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS D_REAL , 0 AS IS_APPROX FROM CHK_PAIR Q WHERE Q.PAIR IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_LIKE(Q.PAIR, '=[0-9]+/[0-9]+$') UNION ALL SELECT R.USER_KEY , R.USER_ID , R.CHK_DATE , R.SRC_SYSTEM , R.REG_DT , CASE WHEN R.CHK_IP IS NULL OR R.CHK_IP = '-' THEN 'NOIP' ELSE R.CHK_IP END AS IPV , NVL(R.D_TOT , 0) AS D_TOT , NVL(R.D_REAL, 0) AS D_REAL , 1 AS IS_APPROX FROM CHK_RAW R WHERE (R.CHK_IPD IS NULL OR R.CHK_IPD = '-') AND NVL(R.D_TOT, 0) > 0 ) , CHK_IP_TODAY AS ( SELECT C.USER_KEY , MIN(C.USER_ID) AS USER_ID , C.IPV , SUM(C.D_TOT) AS TODAY_TOT , SUM(C.D_TOT) - SUM(C.D_REAL) AS TODAY_EXC , SUM(C.D_REAL) AS TODAY_REAL , MAX(C.REG_DT) AS LAST_RECV , COUNT(DISTINCT C.SRC_SYSTEM) AS WAS_CNT , MAX(C.IS_APPROX) AS IS_APPROX FROM CHK_IP C , P WHERE C.CHK_DATE BETWEEN P.DT_FROM8 AND P.DT_TO8 GROUP BY C.USER_KEY , C.IPV ) , CHK_IP_5M AS ( SELECT C.USER_KEY , C.IPV , SUM(C.D_TOT) AS M5_TOT , SUM(C.D_REAL) AS M5_REAL FROM CHK_IP C , P WHERE C.REG_DT >= P.BEF_5M GROUP BY C.USER_KEY , C.IPV ) , BLK_GEO AS ( SELECT UPPER(B.USER_ID) AS USER_KEY , B.USER_ID AS USER_ID , NVL(B.REAL_IP, B.LOGIN_IP) AS IPV , SUBSTR(B.PROC_DT, 1, 14) AS EVT_DT , 'GEO' AS SRC , NVL(B.COUNTRY_CODE,'UNKNOWN') AS COUNTRY_CODE , B.STAT_CD , B.LOGIN_ORGN , B.ORGN_CD , B.LOGIN_IP , B.V_USER_ID , B.BLOCK_REASON , SUBSTR(B.BRWSR_INFO,1,120) AS BRWSR_INFO FROM TB_WB_LOGIN_HIST_BLOCK B , P WHERE SUBSTR(B.PROC_DT, 1, 8) BETWEEN P.DT_FROM8 AND P.DT_TO8 AND UPPER(B.USER_ID) = P.TGT_UID ) , BLK_SEC AS ( SELECT P.TGT_UID AS USER_KEY , REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, 'Login Blocked: [^],]+,([^],]+),', 1, 1, 'i', 1) AS USER_ID , REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, 'Login Blocked: [^],]+,[^],]+,([^],]+)', 1, 1, 'i', 1) AS IPV , A.REG_DT AS EVT_DT , 'SEC' AS SRC , '-' AS COUNTRY_CODE , REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, 'Login Blocked: [^],]+,[^],]+,[^],]+,([^],]+)', 1, 1, 'i', 1) AS STAT_CD , '-' AS LOGIN_ORGN , '-' AS ORGN_CD , REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, 'Login Blocked: [^],]+,[^],]+,([^],]+)', 1, 1, 'i', 1) AS LOGIN_IP , '-' AS V_USER_ID , 'ORA-20001 ' || REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '(Login Blocked: [^],]+)', 1, 1, 'i', 1) AS BLOCK_REASON , '-' AS BRWSR_INFO FROM TB_MONITOR_ALARM A , P WHERE A.REG_DT BETWEEN P.DT_FROM8 || '000000' AND P.DT_TO8 || '235959' AND A.ALARM_TITLE LIKE '%Oracle Job%' AND UPPER(A.ALARM_MSG) LIKE '%LOGIN BLOCKED%' AND UPPER(A.ALARM_MSG) LIKE '%,' || P.TGT_UID || ',%' ) , BLK_ALL AS ( SELECT * FROM BLK_GEO UNION ALL SELECT * FROM BLK_SEC WHERE IPV IS NOT NULL ) , BLK_IP_TODAY AS ( SELECT B.USER_KEY , MIN(B.USER_ID) AS USER_ID , B.IPV , COUNT(*) AS BLK_TODAY_CNT , SUM(CASE WHEN B.EVT_DT >= P.BEF_10M THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BLK_10M_CNT , SUM(CASE WHEN B.SRC = 'GEO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS GEO_CNT , SUM(CASE WHEN B.SRC = 'SEC' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SEC_CNT , COUNT(DISTINCT B.COUNTRY_CODE) AS CC_CNT , MIN(B.EVT_DT) AS BLK_FIRST_DT , MAX(B.EVT_DT) AS BLK_LAST_DT , MAX(B.COUNTRY_CODE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY B.EVT_DT) AS COUNTRY_CODE , MAX(B.STAT_CD) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY B.EVT_DT) AS STAT_CD , MAX(B.LOGIN_ORGN) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY B.EVT_DT) AS LOGIN_ORGN , MAX(B.ORGN_CD) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY B.EVT_DT) AS ORGN_CD , MAX(B.LOGIN_IP) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY B.EVT_DT) AS LOGIN_IP , MAX(B.V_USER_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY B.EVT_DT) AS V_USER_ID , MAX(B.BLOCK_REASON) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY B.EVT_DT) AS BLOCK_REASON , MAX(B.BRWSR_INFO) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY B.EVT_DT) AS BRWSR_INFO FROM BLK_ALL B , P GROUP BY B.USER_KEY , B.IPV ) , LGN_RAW AS ( SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *USER:([^ |]+)' , 1, 1, NULL, 1) AS USER_ID , REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *DATE:([0-9]{8})', 1, 1, NULL, 1) AS LGN_DATE , A.SRC_SYSTEM , A.REG_DT , TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *TOT:([0-9]+)' , 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS LGN_TOT , TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *SUCC:([0-9]+)' , 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS LGN_SUCC , TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *ERR1:([0-9]+)' , 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS LGN_E1 , TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *ERR2:([0-9]+)' , 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS LGN_E2 , TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *ERR3:([0-9]+)' , 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS LGN_E3 , TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *ERR4:([0-9]+)' , 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS LGN_E4 , TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *ERR5:([0-9]+)' , 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS LGN_E5 , TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *ERR_TOT:([0-9]+)', 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS LGN_ERR , REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *LAST:([^|]+)' , 1, 1, NULL, 1) AS LGN_LAST_TS FROM TB_MONITOR_ALARM A , P WHERE A.REG_DT BETWEEN P.DT_FROM8 || '000000' AND P.DT_TO8 || '235959' AND A.ALARM_TITLE LIKE '%로그인 시도%집계%' AND UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *USER:([^ |]+)', 1, 1, NULL, 1)) = P.TGT_UID ) , LGN_SRC AS ( SELECT MIN(R.USER_ID) AS USER_ID , R.SRC_SYSTEM , MAX(R.LGN_TOT) AS TOT_CUM , MAX(R.LGN_SUCC) AS SUCC_CUM , MAX(R.LGN_E1) AS E1_CUM , MAX(R.LGN_E2) AS E2_CUM , MAX(R.LGN_E3) AS E3_CUM , MAX(R.LGN_E4) AS E4_CUM , MAX(R.LGN_E5) AS E5_CUM , MAX(R.LGN_ERR) AS ERR_CUM , MAX(CASE WHEN R.REG_DT < P.BEF_5M THEN R.LGN_TOT END) AS TOT_BASE_5M , MAX(CASE WHEN R.REG_DT < P.BEF_5M THEN R.LGN_ERR END) AS ERR_BASE_5M , MAX(R.LGN_LAST_TS) AS LAST_TS FROM LGN_RAW R , P WHERE R.LGN_DATE BETWEEN P.DT_FROM8 AND P.DT_TO8 GROUP BY R.SRC_SYSTEM , R.LGN_DATE ) , LGN_ONE AS ( SELECT MIN(S.USER_ID) AS USER_ID , SUM(S.TOT_CUM) AS LGN_TODAY_TOT , SUM(S.SUCC_CUM) AS LGN_TODAY_SUCC , SUM(NVL(S.E1_CUM, 0)) AS LGN_TODAY_E1 , SUM(NVL(S.E2_CUM, 0)) AS LGN_TODAY_E2 , SUM(NVL(S.E3_CUM, 0)) AS LGN_TODAY_E3 , SUM(NVL(S.E4_CUM, 0)) AS LGN_TODAY_E4 , SUM(NVL(S.E5_CUM, 0)) AS LGN_TODAY_E5 , SUM(S.ERR_CUM) AS LGN_TODAY_ERR , SUM(S.TOT_CUM - NVL(S.TOT_BASE_5M, 0)) AS LGN_5M_TOT , SUM(S.ERR_CUM - NVL(S.ERR_BASE_5M, 0)) AS LGN_5M_ERR , MAX(S.LAST_TS) AS LGN_LAST_TS FROM LGN_SRC S ) , ME_RAW AS ( SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *USER:([^ |]+)' , 1, 1, NULL, 1) AS USER_ID , REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *DATE:([0-9]{8})' , 1, 1, NULL, 1) AS ME_DATE , NVL( REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *MIN:([0-9]{12})' , 1, 1, NULL, 1), '-') AS ME_MIN , TRIM( REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *URL:([^|]+)' , 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS ME_URL , TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *CNT:([0-9]+)', 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS ME_CNT , A.SRC_SYSTEM FROM TB_MONITOR_ALARM A , P WHERE A.REG_DT BETWEEN P.DT_FROM8 || '000000' AND P.DT_TO8 || '235959' AND A.ALARM_TITLE LIKE '%현재메뉴 불일치%' AND UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *USER:([^ |]+)', 1, 1, NULL, 1)) = P.TGT_UID ) , ME_KEY AS ( SELECT MIN(R.USER_ID) AS USER_ID , REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(R.ME_URL, '^[A-Za-z]+://[^/]+', ''), '\?.*$', '') AS NURL , MAX(R.ME_CNT) AS ME_CNT FROM ME_RAW R , P WHERE R.ME_URL IS NOT NULL AND R.ME_DATE BETWEEN P.DT_FROM8 AND P.DT_TO8 GROUP BY R.SRC_SYSTEM, R.ME_DATE, R.ME_MIN , REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(R.ME_URL, '^[A-Za-z]+://[^/]+', ''), '\?.*$', '') ) , ME_ONE AS ( SELECT MIN(K.USER_ID) AS USER_ID , NVL(SUM(K.ME_CNT), 0) AS ME_TOT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN K.ME_CNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ME_EXC FROM ME_KEY K ) SELECT NVL(C.USER_ID, K.USER_ID) AS USER_ID , NVL(C.IPV , K.IPV) AS IPV , NVL(C.TODAY_TOT , 0) AS TODAY_TOT , NVL(C.TODAY_EXC , 0) AS TODAY_EXC , NVL(C.TODAY_REAL, 0) AS TODAY_REAL , NVL(M.M5_TOT , 0) AS MIN5_TOT , NVL(M.M5_REAL , 0) AS MIN5_REAL , NVL(K.BLK_TODAY_CNT, 0) AS BLK_TODAY_CNT , NVL(K.BLK_10M_CNT , 0) AS BLK_MIN10_CNT , NVL(K.GEO_CNT , 0) AS GEO_CNT , NVL(K.SEC_CNT , 0) AS SEC_CNT , NVL(K.COUNTRY_CODE , '-') AS COUNTRY_CODE , NVL(K.STAT_CD , '-') AS STAT_CD , NVL(K.LOGIN_ORGN , '-') AS LOGIN_ORGN , NVL(K.ORGN_CD , '-') AS ORGN_CD , NVL(K.V_USER_ID , '-') AS V_USER_ID , NVL(K.BLOCK_REASON , '-') AS BLOCK_REASON , NVL(K.BRWSR_INFO , '-') AS BRWSR_INFO , NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(K.BLK_FIRST_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'-') AS BLK_FIRST_F , NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(K.BLK_LAST_DT ,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'-') AS BLK_LAST_F , 0 AS LGN_TODAY_TOT , 0 AS LGN_TODAY_SUCC , 0 AS LGN_TODAY_ERR , 0 AS LGN_MIN5_TOT , 0 AS LGN_MIN5_ERR , '-' AS LGN_LAST_TS , 0 AS LGN_TODAY_E1 , 0 AS LGN_TODAY_E2 , 0 AS LGN_TODAY_E3 , 0 AS LGN_TODAY_E4 , 0 AS LGN_TODAY_E5 , 0 AS ME_TOT , 0 AS ME_EXC , 0 AS ME_REAL , NVL(C.IS_APPROX, 0) AS IS_APPROX , CASE WHEN NVL(C.IPV,K.IPV) = 'NOIP' THEN 'N' WHEN NVL(C.IPV,K.IPV) = 'ETC' THEN 'T' WHEN C.IPV IS NOT NULL AND K.IPV IS NOT NULL AND NVL(M.M5_REAL,0) > 0 THEN 'A' WHEN C.IPV IS NOT NULL AND K.IPV IS NOT NULL THEN 'B' WHEN K.IPV IS NOT NULL THEN 'C' ELSE '-' END AS GUBUN , CASE WHEN C.IPV IS NOT NULL AND K.IPV IS NOT NULL THEN 0 WHEN K.IPV IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS ORD FROM CHK_IP_TODAY C FULL OUTER JOIN BLK_IP_TODAY K ON K.USER_KEY = C.USER_KEY AND K.IPV = C.IPV LEFT OUTER JOIN CHK_IP_5M M ON M.USER_KEY = C.USER_KEY AND M.IPV = C.IPV CROSS JOIN P WHERE NVL(C.USER_KEY, K.USER_KEY) = P.TGT_UID UNION ALL /* 로그인 집계 + 현재메뉴 불일치 — 메시지에 IP 가 없으므로 IP '-' 행 1개로 표시 */ SELECT NVL(L.USER_ID, E.USER_ID) AS USER_ID , '-' AS IPV , 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 , 0, 0, 0, 0 , '-', '-', '-', '-', '-', '-', '-' , '-', '-' , NVL(L.LGN_TODAY_TOT , 0) , NVL(L.LGN_TODAY_SUCC, 0) , NVL(L.LGN_TODAY_ERR , 0) , NVL(L.LGN_5M_TOT , 0) , NVL(L.LGN_5M_ERR , 0) , NVL(L.LGN_LAST_TS , '-') , NVL(L.LGN_TODAY_E1 , 0) , NVL(L.LGN_TODAY_E2 , 0) , NVL(L.LGN_TODAY_E3 , 0) , NVL(L.LGN_TODAY_E4 , 0) , NVL(L.LGN_TODAY_E5 , 0) , NVL(E.ME_TOT, 0) , NVL(E.ME_EXC, 0) , NVL(E.ME_TOT, 0) - NVL(E.ME_EXC, 0) , 0 AS IS_APPROX , 'L' AS GUBUN , 3 AS ORD FROM LGN_ONE L CROSS JOIN ME_ONE E WHERE L.USER_ID IS NOT NULL OR NVL(E.ME_TOT, 0) > 0 ORDER BY ORD , BLK_MIN10_CNT DESC , MIN5_REAL DESC , TODAY_REAL DESC , IPV

WITH P AS ( SELECT #{chkDay1} AS DT_FROM8 , #{chkDay2} AS DT_TO8 , UPPER(TRIM(#{ipUserId})) AS TGT_UID FROM DUAL ) , HC AS ( SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(NVL(X.BRWSR_INFO, '-'), GROUP BY NURL, NVL(LOGIN_IP, 'NOIP') ) , HG AS ( SELECT NURL , SUM(CNT) AS CHK_CNT , COUNT(*) AS IP_CNT , LISTAGG(LOGIN_IP || '(' || CNT || ')', ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CNT DESC, LOGIN_IP) AS IP_LIST , MIN(FIRST_DT) AS FIRST_DT , MAX(LAST_DT) AS LAST_DT FROM HI GROUP BY NURL ) , MR AS ( SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *DATE:([0-9]{8})' , 1, 1, NULL, 1) AS ME_DATE , NVL( REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *MIN:([0-9]{12})' , 1, 1, NULL, 1), '-') AS ME_MIN , TRIM( REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *URL:([^|]+)' , 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS ME_URL , TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *CNT:([0-9]+)', 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS ME_CNT , A.SRC_SYSTEM FROM TB_MONITOR_ALARM A , P WHERE A.REG_DT BETWEEN P.DT_FROM8 || '000000' AND P.DT_TO8 || '235959' AND A.ALARM_TITLE LIKE '%현재메뉴 불일치%' AND UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *USER:([^ |]+)', 1, 1, NULL, 1)) = P.TGT_UID ) , MK AS ( SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(R.ME_URL, '^[A-Za-z]+://[^/]+', ''), '\?.*$', '') AS NURL , MAX(R.ME_CNT) AS ME_CNT FROM MR R , P WHERE R.ME_URL IS NOT NULL AND R.ME_DATE BETWEEN P.DT_FROM8 AND P.DT_TO8 GROUP BY R.SRC_SYSTEM, R.ME_DATE, R.ME_MIN , REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(R.ME_URL, '^[A-Za-z]+://[^/]+', ''), '\?.*$', '') ) , MG AS ( SELECT NURL, SUM(ME_CNT) AS ME_CNT FROM MK GROUP BY NURL ) , UR AS ( SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *URLD:([^|]+)' , 1, 1, NULL, 1)) AS URLD , REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *DATE:([0-9]{8})', 1, 1, NULL, 1) AS CHK_DATE FROM TB_MONITOR_ALARM A , P WHERE A.REG_DT BETWEEN P.DT_FROM8 || '000000' AND P.DT_TO8 || '235959' AND A.ALARM_TITLE LIKE '%조회건수%집계%' AND A.ALARM_MSG LIKE '%| URLD:%' AND UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *USER:([^ |]+)', 1, 1, NULL, 1)) = P.TGT_UID ) , UP AS ( SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(R.URLD, '[^,]+', 1, L.LV)) AS PAIR FROM UR R , P , (SELECT LEVEL AS LV FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 60) L WHERE R.CHK_DATE BETWEEN P.DT_FROM8 AND P.DT_TO8 AND R.URLD IS NOT NULL AND R.URLD <> '-' AND L.LV <= REGEXP_COUNT(R.URLD, ',') + 1 ) , UG AS ( SELECT SUBSTR(Q.PAIR, 1, INSTR(Q.PAIR, '=', -1) - 1) AS NURL , SUM(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(Q.PAIR, '=([0-9]+)/[0-9]+$', 1, 1, NULL, 1))) AS WH_TOT , SUM(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(Q.PAIR, '/([0-9]+)$' , 1, 1, NULL, 1))) AS WH_REAL FROM UP Q WHERE Q.PAIR IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_LIKE(Q.PAIR, '=[0-9]+/[0-9]+$') GROUP BY SUBSTR(Q.PAIR, 1, INSTR(Q.PAIR, '=', -1) - 1) ) , UU AS ( /* URL 합집합 + 예외 URL 판정 — 조인 전에 판정해 NURL 모호성(ORA-00918) 방지 */ SELECT X.NURL , CASE WHEN X.NURL = 'NOURL' THEN 'YN 호출(URL 없음)' WHEN X.NURL = 'ETC' THEN 'URL 표기초과 합산' ELSE END AS EXC_RULE , CASE WHEN X.NURL IN ('NOURL','ETC') THEN 'N' WHEN THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_EXC FROM ( SELECT NURL FROM HG UNION SELECT NURL FROM UG UNION SELECT NURL FROM MG ) X ) SELECT U.NURL AS URL , NVL(G.CHK_CNT, 0) AS CHK_CNT , NVL(W.WH_TOT , 0) AS WH_TOT , NVL(W.WH_REAL, 0) AS WH_REAL , NVL(M.ME_CNT , 0) AS ME_CNT , NVL(G.IP_CNT , 0) AS IP_CNT , NVL(G.IP_LIST, '-') AS IP_LIST , U.EXC_RULE AS EXC_RULE , U.IS_EXC AS IS_EXC , NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(G.FIRST_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'-') AS FIRST_F , NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(G.LAST_DT ,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'-') AS LAST_F FROM UU U LEFT OUTER JOIN HG G ON G.NURL = U.NURL LEFT OUTER JOIN UG W ON W.NURL = U.NURL LEFT OUTER JOIN MG M ON M.NURL = U.NURL WHERE U.NURL IS NOT NULL ORDER BY NVL(W.WH_TOT, 0) + NVL(G.CHK_CNT, 0) + NVL(M.ME_CNT, 0) DESC , 1

/* UserWebHistMapper.getUserWebChkCntIpDiag */
WITH P AS ( SELECT #{chkDay1} AS DT_FROM8 , #{chkDay2} AS DT_TO8 , #{chkDay1} || '000000' AS DT_FROM , #{chkDay2} || '235959' AS DT_TO , UPPER(TRIM(#{ipUserId})) AS TGT_UID FROM DUAL ) SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MONITOR_ALARM A WHERE A.REG_DT BETWEEN P.DT_FROM AND P.DT_TO AND A.ALARM_TITLE LIKE '%조회건수%집계%' AND UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *USER:([^ |]+)', 1, 1, NULL, 1)) = P.TGT_UID ) AS DG_CHK_ALL , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MONITOR_ALARM A WHERE A.REG_DT BETWEEN P.DT_FROM AND P.DT_TO AND A.ALARM_TITLE LIKE '%조회건수%집계%' AND A.ALARM_MSG LIKE '%| IPD:%' AND UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *USER:([^ |]+)', 1, 1, NULL, 1)) = P.TGT_UID ) AS DG_CHK_IPD , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MONITOR_ALARM A WHERE A.REG_DT BETWEEN P.DT_FROM AND P.DT_TO AND A.ALARM_TITLE LIKE '%로그인 시도%집계%' AND UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ALARM_MSG, '\| *USER:([^ |]+)', 1, 1, NULL, 1)) = P.TGT_UID ) AS DG_LGN , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_WB_LOGIN_HIST_BLOCK B WHERE UPPER(B.USER_ID) = P.TGT_UID AND SUBSTR(B.PROC_DT, 1, 8) BETWEEN P.DT_FROM8 AND P.DT_TO8 ) AS DG_BLK , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_WB_LOGIN_HIST_BLOCK B WHERE UPPER(B.USER_ID) = P.TGT_UID ) AS DG_BLK_ALL , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MONITOR_ALARM A WHERE A.REG_DT BETWEEN P.DT_FROM AND P.DT_TO AND A.ALARM_TITLE LIKE '%Oracle Job%' AND UPPER(A.ALARM_MSG) LIKE '%LOGIN BLOCKED%' AND UPPER(A.ALARM_MSG) LIKE '%,' || P.TGT_UID || ',%' ) AS DG_SEC FROM P

/* UserWebHistMapper.getUserInfoLogList */
SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(L.PROC_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS PROC_DT , L.PROC_FG , CASE L.PROC_FG WHEN 'I' THEN '등록' WHEN 'U' THEN '수정' WHEN 'D' THEN '삭제' ELSE L.PROC_FG END AS PROC_FG_NM , L.USER_ID , L.B_USER_STAT_FG , L.USER_STAT_FG , CASE WHEN L.B_USER_STAT_FG IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE L.B_USER_STAT_FG || '(' || DECODE(L.B_USER_STAT_FG, '00','정상', '10','로그인횟수초과', '20','비밀번호만료' , '30','90일경과', '31','180일경과', '40','휴면', '50','일시정지', '99','초기비밀번호', '기타') || ')' END || ' → ' || CASE WHEN L.USER_STAT_FG IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE L.USER_STAT_FG || '(' || DECODE(L.USER_STAT_FG, '00','정상', '10','로그인횟수초과', '20','비밀번호만료' , '30','90일경과', '31','180일경과', '40','휴면', '50','일시정지', '99','초기비밀번호', '기타') || ')' END AS STAT_CHG , CASE WHEN L.B_USER_STAT_FG = '50' AND NVL(L.USER_STAT_FG, '#') <> '50' THEN '해제' WHEN NVL(L.B_USER_STAT_FG, '#') <> '50' AND L.USER_STAT_FG = '50' THEN '정지' ELSE NULL END AS PAUSE_CHG , RTRIM( CASE WHEN NVL(L.B_USER_STAT_FG , '#') <> NVL(L.USER_STAT_FG , '#') THEN '사용자상태,' END || CASE WHEN NVL(L.B_USE_YN , '#') <> NVL(L.USE_YN , '#') THEN '사용여부,' END || CASE WHEN NVL(L.B_AUTH_GRP_CD , '#') <> NVL(L.AUTH_GRP_CD , '#') THEN '권한그룹,' END || CASE WHEN NVL(L.B_USER_PWD , '#') <> NVL(L.USER_PWD , '#') THEN '비밀번호,' END || CASE WHEN NVL(L.B_LAST_PWD_CHG_DT , '#') <> NVL(L.LAST_PWD_CHG_DT , '#') THEN '비밀번호변경일시,' END || CASE WHEN NVL(L.B_LOGIN_FAIL_CNT , -1 ) <> NVL(L.LOGIN_FAIL_CNT , -1 ) THEN '로그인실패건수,' END || CASE WHEN NVL(L.B_LAST_LOGIN_DT , '#') <> NVL(L.LAST_LOGIN_DT , '#') THEN '최종로그인,' END || CASE WHEN NVL(L.B_AREA_FG , '#') <> NVL(L.AREA_FG , '#') THEN '지역구분,' END || CASE WHEN NVL(L.B_LOGIN_AUTO_SERIAL , '#') <> NVL(L.LOGIN_AUTO_SERIAL , '#') THEN '자동로그인,' END || CASE WHEN NVL(L.B_MOB_LOGIN_AUTO_SERIAL,'#')<> NVL(L.MOB_LOGIN_AUTO_SERIAL,'#') THEN '모바일자동로그인,' END , ',') AS CHG_ITEMS , NVL(L.B_USE_YN, '-') || ' → ' || NVL(L.USE_YN, '-') AS USE_YN_CHG , NVL(L.B_AUTH_GRP_CD, '-') || ' → ' || NVL(L.AUTH_GRP_CD, '-') AS AUTH_GRP_CHG , NVL(TO_CHAR(L.B_LOGIN_FAIL_CNT), '-') || ' → ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(L.LOGIN_FAIL_CNT), '-') AS FAIL_CNT_CHG , CASE WHEN NVL(L.B_USER_PWD, '#') <> NVL(L.USER_PWD, '#') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PWD_CHG_YN , NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(L.LAST_PWD_CHG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), '-') AS LAST_PWD_CHG_DT , NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(L.LAST_LOGIN_DT , 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), '-') AS LAST_LOGIN_DT , NVL(L.MOD_ID, L.B_MOD_ID) AS MOD_ID , NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NVL(L.MOD_DT, L.B_MOD_DT), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), '-') AS MOD_DT FROM TB_LG_WB_USER_INFO_LOG L WHERE L.PROC_DT BETWEEN #{chkDay1} || '000000' AND #{chkDay2} || '235959'
AND UPPER(L.USER_ID) = UPPER(#{userId})
ORDER BY L.PROC_DT DESC
